test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 6% per year rate of interest for 4 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per year

Time (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹3000 × 6 × 4) / 100

⇒ SI = (72000) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹720

**The simple interest is ₹720.**
